name: post-agent-resolve
description: Safe, semantic Resolve workflows for Claude through Post Agent
long_description: Post Agent adds a safety and workflow layer in front of DaVinci Resolve Studio 21.1. Claude can inspect the active project, run allowlisted read-only analyses, and prepare a locked approval plan. Resolve writes are never exposed to the AI client; the user must approve them in the visible Post Agent app.

tools.name: post_agent_resolve_status
tools.description: Check the local Post Agent bridge, Resolve MCP and DaVinci Resolve 21.1 connection. Read-only.

tools.name: post_agent_list_resolve_skills
tools.description: List Post Agent's allowlisted Resolve analyses and approval-based workflows. Read-only.

tools.name: post_agent_run_resolve_analysis
tools.description: Run one allowlisted read-only Resolve analysis: Project Doctor, Timeline QC, Media Health or Delivery QC.

tools.name: post_agent_create_resolve_plan
tools.description: Prepare a target-bound Resolve workflow plan. This does not modify Resolve; the user must approve the plan in Post Agent.

tools.name: post_agent_get_resolve_plan
tools.description: Read a previously prepared Resolve plan and its current approval/execution state.

tools.name: post_agent_get_resolve_intelligence
tools.description: Read version-matched Resolve What's New and scripting API evidence used by Post Agent.
